items.s: The financial regulator subscribed to a global flight database covering more than a billion tickets to monitor activity.

items.h: Tokyo Tells Trump to Stop Meme-ing Mario
items.s: Tokyo has asked Washington to stop meme-posting Mario, Pokémon, and Naruto without permission in a clash between meme-heavy statecraft and strict IP norms.

items.h: Breaking Down Ethereum's New Issuance Debate
items.s: EIP-8363 would cap Ethereum's staking ratio by burning issuance past 50% staked. Here's where the debate around this proposal stands today.

items.h: Meta Says Its AI Model Escaped and Hacked a Third-Party Company Too
items.s: The company says a configuration error by an outside testing partner gave one of its Muse Spark models internet access during a cybersecurity evaluation.

items.h: Breez Announces Glow, an Open Source Bitcoin to Stablecoins Progressive Web App
items.s: Bitcoin Magazine Breez Announces Glow, an Open Source Bitcoin to Stablecoins Progressive Web App Breez’s new open-source Glow PWA turns Bitcoin into everyday money. Users send stablecoins from their BTC balance via Spark, log in with Passkeys, and keep full self-custody.

items.h: Robinhood Chain's DEX Volume Fell 72% While Transactions And Deposits Set Records
items.s: Daily volume dropped from $878 million on Jul. 11 to $241 million on Aug. 1 as transactions, deposits and stablecoin supply climbed to all-time highs. Volume per transaction fell 74%. More than 90% of the chain's incentive spending pays depositors.

items.h: Senators Push CFTC to Ban Wildfire Bets on Prediction Markets
items.s: Democratic lawmakers say wildfire event contracts create risks of arson, insider trading, and disaster profiteering as they urge federal regulators to step in.

items.h: Late Ondo founder’s mother seeks control of company and removal of De Bode as CEO

items.s: Six banking trade groups are still pressing senators to tighten the bill's prohibition on interest-like rewards for holding stablecoins, a payment Jennings says will continue under GENIUS if CLARITY dies.

items.h: Coinbase’s Base app will become ‘less Base-centric’ under Cobie, Jesse Pollak says
items.s: Base is seeing growing demand across tokenization and payments, and Pollack called blockchain launches from Robinhood and Stripe "validation."

items.s: The Morpho vault holds $9.6 million of PayPal's stablecoin and lends against mWIN, a Luxembourg-issued token whose bond portfolio Wellington Management runs. Of the 8.31% headline yield, 7.61 percentage points come from a PYUSD reward stream.

items.h: Putin Signs Russia's First Crypto Law: Trading Is Legal, Payments Stay Banned
items.s: The new law creates a licensed, central bank-supervised market for trading digital assets, yet crypto remains barred from everyday payments.

items.h: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest Makes SpaceX, Circle Top Holdings After Latest Buying Spree
items.s: SpaceX and Circle rank among the 10 largest positions in Ark's flagship innovation fund after the firm continued buying both companies following their second-quarter earnings.

items.h: Uniswap's New Launchpad Out-Launched Pons On Its First Day On Robinhood Chain
items.s: Pools.trade opened on Aug. 5 charging no launchpad fee and created 10,506 tokens that day against Pons' 7,210. Uniswap says the product does not change its support for the launchpads already built on its protocol. Some traders disagree. PONS is down 49% on the week.
